description: Token Liquidity. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/liquidity and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching total USD liquidity for any Solana token. Aggregates liquidity across all trading markets to assess depth before trading.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/liquidity.

name: get-token-liquidity
title: Token Liquidity
